projects.name: Secure Full-Stack Authentication Platform

projects.name: urlfckr

projects.description_en: Multithreaded Python web crawler for reconnaissance. Discovers subdomains and application paths. Configurable crawl depth, rate limiting, custom HTTP headers and JSON export.
